messages:
jen: FYI escalated from Acme — they see tool results getting attached to the wrong tool when we fan out two tool calls in parallel. customer says outputs are swapped intermittently.

jen: repro details they gave: curl to /v1/chat with function calls array of two tools, both invoked in parallel by the model. sometimes toolA result ends up under toolB in our metadata. Correlation id: corr=abc123-ff.

jen: their minimal request (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-1","input":"find info","functions":[{"name":"web_lookup","schema":{}},{"name":"kb_query","schema":{}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

jen: they attached a snippet of our returned event stream where the tool_result id assignments look wrong:
```
[INFO] 2026-06-02T15:22:01Z trace=tr-789 call_id=call-1 tool=web_lookup result_token=rt-55 -> payload {...}
[INFO] 2026-06-02T15:22:01Z trace=tr-789 call_id=call-2 tool=kb_query    result_token=rt-55 -> payload {...}
```

jen: note both calls show the same result_token (rt-55) — customer says sometimes the payload content belongs to the other tool.

alex (eng-runtime): ack. thanks for the repro, jen. tagging @maria and @liu. this looks like a result_token collision under parallel execution. can you paste full trace id or response headers (x-rw-trace, x-rw-corr)?

jen (support): paste of response headers from customer: `x-rw-trace: tr-789`, `x-rw-corr: abc123-ff`, `request-id: r-20260602-77`

maria (eng-sre): thanks. i pulled traces for tr-789 from tracing. i see two async tasks spawned and both pick up the same ephemeral token from the token pool. not enough entropy when token pool refcounting races.

liu (ml): hypothesis: when we fan out, we were reusing a short token derived from model choices instead of generating unique tool-call uuids. under high QPS two parallel calls can get same short id. log backs this up.

alex (eng-runtime): repro locally: ran stress harness that fires 1000 double-tool requests with small sleep between model decisions. saw ~0.7% of requests with duplicate result_token. attached local log: `dup_count=7 / 1000`.

alex (eng-runtime): temporary mitigation: recommend customers serialize tool calls or set model to return explicit function sequence (no parallel). jen can you ask Acme to try serializing and verify?

jen (support): customer tried serializing and confirmed no misattributions after 30 min of tests. requested ETA on permanent fix and whether they'll get credit.

maria (eng-sre): plan: patch token generator to use 128-bit randomness and atomically allocate from pool. i'll open a PR with tests for parallel allocation.

alex (eng-runtime): also adding extra logging: include per-tool-call uuid and correlation mapping in event stream to make postmortems easier. will canary in eng-runtime pool.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: patch/rw/tool-token-uniq -> canary group eng-runtime-canary at 2026-06-02T18:00:00Z by alex

ops-bot: incident INC-2026 created by jen — severity P2. customer: Acme. owner: alex.

maria (eng-sre): ETA for canary: 2h, full rollout after 6h if no regressions.

alex (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.internal/rw/eng-runtime/pulls/2145 — patch adds crypto-rand uid per tool-call, updates tracing to log `tool_call_uuid` and `result_token` separately.

liu (ml): note: also check the handler that merges tool_results into main streaming response — ensure association key uses tool_call_uuid not short token. otherwise mismatch still possible.

alex (eng-runtime): good catch. i updated merge logic in same PR. added unit + race tests.

jen (support): told customer: workaround confirmed, hotfix rolling, canary in 2h, expect full rollout within 8h. offered 2 days credit on hosted plan; they accepted.

maria (eng-sre): postmortem task assigned to eng-runtime to add long-term monitoring metric `dup_result_token_rate`.

jen (support): closing customer loop now, will keep thread updated with canary metrics. thanks team :thumbsup:

alex (eng-runtime): will post canary results here once we have metrics.

maria (eng-sre): canary healthy at +3h, dup_rate -> 0, rolling to 25% now.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026 status -> mitigated (canary confirmed), will monitor for 24h then resolve.

jen (support): Acme confirmed fix on their side after our rollout, happy with credit. closing incident later today.

alex (eng-runtime): follow-up: we'll add a short KB for customers with high-parallel tool fans: "if you see tool_result mapping issues, set function_call: sequence or update client to pass tool_call_uuid"

jen (support): adding KB draft to docs backlog.

jen (support): thread resolved for now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex (eng-runtime): will post canary results here once we have metrics.

maria (eng-sre): canary healthy at +3h, dup_rate -> 0, rolling to 25% now.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026 status -> mitigated (canary confirmed), will monitor for 24h then resolve.

jen (support): Acme confirmed fix on their side after our rollout, happy with credit. closing incident later today.
